name: Dataflows - New Output Destination: SharePoint Excel Files
description: Taking the ability to output data results to SharePoint Files to the next level, we plan to provide the ability to output to Excel (XLSX) file format. This brings additional capabilities such as partitioning (e.g. to multiple worksheets) and conditional data formatting that will ease data exploration and consumption for Citizen Users.
